verdict.rationale: Real-time multi-session sync is a fair axis for a collaborative work-tracking tool like Jira, so the story applies. However, nothing in the pack documents changes propagating live across open sessions without a refresh. The 'stay up-to-date' and automation claims describe views and status automation, not real-time presence or live updates, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
